name: Karine Silva
facts: Karine Silva de Almeida is a Brazilian professional mixed martial artist who competes in the women's Flyweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). As of September 19, 2026, she is #14 in the Meta UFC women's flyweight rankings..
